commands.author: sunlit-deng

target.title: fix: support baseURL alias in memory embedding provider config resolution
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When users configure `models.providers.*.baseURL` (capital `URL`) for a provider, the strict schema used to reject/drop that alias instead of exposing the canonical `baseUrl` field downstream.

Fixes #93396.

## Changes

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `src/config/zod-schema.core.ts` | Accept `models.providers.*.baseURL`, normalize to canonical `baseUrl`, delete the alias before downstream code reads the provider config, and reject configs that set both spellings. |
| `src/config/types.models.ts` | Add `baseURL` to the input config type as a compatibility alias. |
| `src/config/schema.hints.ts` | Walk Zod pipes while collecting schema hint paths so transformed provider schemas keep sensitive URL metadata for `baseUrl` and its `baseURL` alias. |
| `src/config/schema.help.ts` | Add help text for the `baseURL` alias field. |
| `src/config/schema.labels.ts` | Add display label for the `baseURL` alias field. |
| `src/config/schema.test.ts` | Covers `baseURL` normalization, alias deletion, duplicate-spelling rejection, and sensitive URL metadata on the alias path. |
| `src/config/schema.hints.test.ts` | Covers discovery of the `models.providers.*.baseURL` sensitive URL hint path. |
| `src/config/redact-snapshot.test.ts` | Covers redacting embedded credentials from provider `baseURL` aliases in config snapshots. |
| `packages/net-policy/src/redact-sensitive-url.ts` | Treats `models.providers.*.baseURL` as a sensitive URL config path alongside `baseUrl`. |
| `packages/net-policy/src/redact-sensitive-url.test.ts` | Covers the alias in the shared sensitive URL path predicate. |
| `src/agents/memory-search.test.ts` | Strengthens `baseURL` coverage so schema-normalized config resolves the built-in OpenAI memory adapter and its default model. |
| `docs/gateway/config-tools.md` | Document `baseURL` as a compatibility alias normalized to `baseUrl`. |
| `docs/.generated/config-baseline.sha256` | Refresh baseline hash after schema changes. |

## Evidence

**Behavior addressed:** `baseURL` in authored provider config is accepted by the production schema, normalized to `baseUrl`, and the downstream embedding path resolves the correct provider, model, and endpoint.

**Redacted real run transcript:**

```text
=== Input config ===
{
  "models": {
    "providers": {
      "openai": {
        "baseURL": "http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1",
        "models": []
      }
    }
  },
  "agents": {
    "defaults": {
      "memorySearch": {
        "provider": "openai"
      }
    }
  }
}

=== Step 1: Schema baseURL alias normalized ===
  Validation: OK
  [ALIAS DELETED] Provider openai has baseURL removed from output
  Canonical baseUrl: http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1

=== Step 2: Memory search config resolves with alias-origin config ===
  Provider: openai
  Model: text-embedding-3-small
  Sources: ["memory"]

=== Step 3: Compare with canonical baseUrl config ===
  Provider matches canonical: true
  Model matches canonical: true
  => baseURL alias config produces identical resolution as canonical baseUrl config

  baseURL alias deleted from output: YES
  Memory adapter resolves correctly: YES
  Alias <-> canonical consistency: YES
  VERDICT: PROVEN
```

**Endpoint delivery proof (request received by the configured endpoint):**

Beyond schema/config resolution, a `baseURL`-only provider config is parsed by the production `ModelsConfigSchema` and the resolved endpoint drives a real embedding request through `createRemoteEmbeddingProvider` to the configured endpoint. The loopback server actually receives the request (private test IP allowed past the SSRF guard; auth redacted):

```text
input alias:      baseURL=http://127.0.0.1:41341/v1
normalized:       baseUrl=http://127.0.0.1:41341/v1 | baseURL present=false
endpoint received: POST /v1/embeddings
request model:     text-embedding-3-small
returned vector:   [0.11, 0.22, 0.33]
```

**Exact command run:** `node --import tsx scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/config/schema.test.ts src/agents/memory-search.test.ts`

```text
[test] passed 2 Vitest shards in 57.33s
Test Files: 1 passed (1), 1 passed (1)
Tests: schema.test.ts (57), memory-search.test.ts (38)
```

**Format / lint / type checks:**

```text
oxfmt: All matched files use the correct format.
oxlint: passed (no errors)
tsgo core: passed
tsgo core-test: passed
```

**Config baseline:**

```text
OK docs/.generated/config-baseline.sha256
```

The transcript above is a real run against the PR-head source, not staged test output. The schema:
1. Accepts `baseURL` input
2. Normalizes to canonical `baseUrl`
3. Deletes the alias from output
4. Resolves the OpenAI memory adapter (`text-embedding-3-small`) identically to native `baseUrl` config
